title: Metric definition + re-derivation
description: Define a governed metric, re-derive it through an explicit tool requirement, and reconcile results.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: metric-definition-rederivation
  title: Metric definition + re-derivation
  description: Define a governed metric, re-derive it through an explicit tool requirement, and reconcile results.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Produce an owner-approved metric contract and independently reproducible calculation.
  policies: { maxConcurrency: 3, onFailure: stop, requireApprovalFor: [owner-approval] }
  nodes:
    - id: metric-request
      kind: input
      name: Metric request and source inventory
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [text]
        properties: { text: { type: string } }
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: steward
      kind: agent
      name: Define governed metric contract
      templateRef: data-02
      role: Metric steward responsible for semantic consistency and decision context.
      prompt: Define the metric owner, purpose, grain, formula, exclusions, dimensions, freshness, and known limitations. Surface conflicting definitions and require accountable owner approval.
      capabilities: { skills: [metric-governance, decision-framing], tools: [read, edit], permissions: [workspace-write] }
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: engineer
      kind: agent
      name: Implement independent derivation plan
      templateRef: data-01
      role: Analytics engineer who turns governed metric definitions into testable transformations.
      prompt: Translate the supplied metric contract into explicit grain, joins, filters, dimensions, tests, and reconciliation queries. Preserve lineage and never silently change business meaning.
      capabilities:
        skills: [analytics-engineering, data-modeling]
        tools: [read, query]
        connectors: [mcp:postgres]
        permissions: [read-only]
      config: { workingDirectory: analytics/metrics }
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: rederive
      kind: tool
      name: Host-resolved metric query
      summary: Execute the approved reconciliation query; Ladder Graph does not run it.
      capabilities: { skills: [], tools: [query], connectors: [mcp:postgres], permissions: [read-only] }
    - id: reconcile
      kind: aggregator
      name: Compare reported and re-derived values
      config: { aggregation: vote }
    - id: owner-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Metric owner approves definition and variance
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Governed metric contract and reconciliation
  edges:
    - { id: e1, from: metric-request, to: steward, kind: data }
    - { id: e2, from: steward, to: engineer, kind: data }
    - { id: e3, from: engineer, to: rederive, kind: dependency }
    - { id: e4, from: steward, to: reconcile, kind: data }
    - { id: e5, from: rederive, to: reconcile, kind: data }
    - { id: e6, from: reconcile, to: owner-approval, kind: dependency }
    - { id: e7, from: owner-approval, to: result, kind: dependency, condition: approved }
